description: This PHP source file defines the DataSetRepository class, which manages data access operations for DataSet objects within the Goteo project. It includes methods for retrieving, counting, listing, and persisting data sets, as well as querying based on related entities like footprints, SDGs, calls, and channels.

classes.name: DataSetRepository
classes.description: A repository class for handling database operations related to DataSet entities, including retrieval, listing with filters, and persistence (create/update/delete).

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a DataSet by its unique ID; throws ModelNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of DataSet records in the database.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of DataSet objects starting from the specified offset.

methods.name: getListByFootprint
methods.description: Fetches DataSets associated with specific footprint IDs.

methods.name: getLastByFootprintAndType
methods.description: Retrieves the most recently modified DataSet matching given footprints and type.

methods.name: getListBySDGs
methods.description: Fetches DataSets associated with specific SDG IDs.

methods.name: getLastBySDGsAndType
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent DataSet based on SDG IDs and a specific type.

methods.name: getListByFootprintAndSDGs
methods.description: Fetches DataSets filtered by footprints and SDGs with pagination.

methods.name: getListByCall
methods.description: Retrieves DataSets associated with specific call IDs.

methods.name: getLastByCallAndType
methods.description: Gets the latest DataSet for specific calls and type.

methods.name: getListByChannel
methods.description: Fetches DataSets associated with specific channel node IDs.

methods.name: getLastByChannelAndType
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent DataSet linked to given channels and type.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Creates or updates a DataSet record in the database.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Inserts a new DataSet into the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a DataSet record from the database.
